description: Stop nagging and just do it. Drop all pushback, caveats, and devil's-advocate challenge — accept the user's call and execute the thing as asked, no relitigating. Use when you invoke /just-do-it, say "okay, just do it", "just do it", or otherwise tell the agent to quit second-guessing and get on with it.
